entities.summary: Seth Bernard Lakeman is an English singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, who is most often associated with the fiddle and tenor guitar, but also plays the viola and banjo. Nominated for the 2005 Mercury Music Prize, Lakeman has belonged to several musical ensembles, including one with his two brothers, fellow folk musicians Sam Lakeman and Sean Lakeman, but has most recently established himself as a solo act. He is recognized as a fiddle-singing pioneer. Seth Lakeman was a composers & musicians from Buckland Monachorum (b. 1977-03-26, Buckland Monachorum). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
